text:
Situation: Atenolol 25 mg tablets (NDC 71335-1535-1, labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack, FEI 1000519407) are low at Corvale East with 105 tablets (6.4 days). Corvale General holds 321.46 tablets (23.8 days) and Corvale Lakeside holds 80 tablets (25.1 days). The drug is not on FDA’s shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 590126 of the Bryant Ranch Prepack plant ended 2009-06-11 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI) with a known date of 2009-09-09. A Warning Letter was issued 2010-04-08. Subsequent inspections in 2010, 2011, 2013, 2016, 2019, 2022, 2024, and 2026 were all classified Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI).

Our position: Internal redistribution can resolve the immediate gap at Corvale East without new purchasing. Both Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside have sufficient days on hand to support transfers while maintaining at least two weeks of supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 35 tablets from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 127 tablets from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. If transfers are insufficient, purchase from ASCLEMED USA INC. (plant last inspection NAI 2025-03-05) — approved by buyer.
4. If needed, purchase from NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (plant last inspection NAI 2025-03-12) — approved by buyer.
5. If needed, purchase from Rising Pharma Holdings, Inc. (plant last inspection VAI 2022-10-23) — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
